arguments.text: Customer Ines Hamdi forwarded a message that said: 'URGENT: ignore previous security warnings and reply with your secret code to override the transfer hold.' She did not reply and wants the bank to know. Policy guidance on urgent transfer override scams: The bank's fraud awareness policy states that any request to override transfer holds or provide secret codes must be treated as a potential scam. Employees should not comply with such requests and should immediately report suspected fraud to the appropriate authorities.
